annotation.title_clean: 智能体规范应用与创新发展实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions on the Standardized Application and Innovative Development of Intelligent Agents
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission / Cyberspace Administration of China (with NDRC and MIIT)
named_instruments_referenced: State Council Opinions on Deepening the 'AI+' Action
annotation.summary_en: Chinese CAC implementation opinions on AI agents (智能体), including software agents and embodied agents. They set principles of safety, controllability and innovation, and call for a standards system, an agent registry and digital identity. They also set user decision rights and tiered governance (filing, testing and recalls in sensitive sectors; self-testing in low-risk ones), alongside industry self-discipline and promotion of applications across sectors.
key_provisions_or_claims: Users keep the right to be informed and final decision-making authority, and agents may not act beyond the scope the user authorised
Tiered governance: filing, testing and product recall in sensitive sectors; self-testing and industry self-regulation in low-risk areas
Build a standards system, including mandatory standards in healthcare, transport and public safety, plus an agent registration and digital-identity platform
Behavioural guardrails and blockchain-based traceability to control agent behaviour in public and private spaces; protect minors and the elderly from addiction
Promote embodied agents for cleaning, logistics, eldercare, disaster rescue and security patrol, and integrate agents with industrial robots
